description: This file defines the NotesService class, which provides an in-memory service layer for managing notes. The class includes methods for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching notes, as well as a singleton instance for external use.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: A service layer class managing note objects in memory, providing CRUD operations and a search feature.

methods.name: Dict create_note(self, title: str, content: str, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new note with given title, content, and optional tags, and returns its dictionary representation.

methods.name: List[Dict] list_notes(self, include_archived: bool = True)
methods.description: Returns a list of notes, optionally filtering out archived ones.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] update_note( self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates fields of a note identified by note_id; returns the updated note as a dictionary.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returns True if successful.

methods.name: List[Dict] search(self, query: str)
methods.description: Performs a simple search in note titles and contents; returns matching notes.
